breakdown.description: The formulation is introduced as displacement-based compressible neo-Hookean, but later switches to a mixed incompressible J = 1 constraint.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification consistently uses a displacement-only compressible neo-Hookean formulation throughout. It defines the strain energy density psi = (mu/2)*(tr(C) - 3) - mu*ln(J) + (lambda/2)*(ln(J))^2, uses a single VectorFunctionSpace for displacement only, and never introduces a mixed formulation or an incompressibility constraint (J = 1). This correctly resolves the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt contradictorily introduced a mixed displacement-pressure formulation with J = 1 enforcement after describing a compressible neo-Hookean problem.
